title: Shorts from a long recording
summary: Cut standalone vertical shorts, reels and clips out of the user's own long recording: hook in 3 s, whole sentences, payoff at the end, the user approves each clip.

notFor.when: the user wants the whole recording cut, captioned or reframed as one video
a new film cut to music from stock or supplied b-roll, not from the user's speech
cut-downs of a customer case study or testimonial interview, made with the case-study film

alternatives.when: approved ShortSelections and a chapter manifest already exist for a timeline project

qa: Each short's hook sentence starts within 3 s and the clip makes sense with no episode context
Each short ends on its payoff with a hard end, no fade, and fits the length band of every platform it targets
Captions in every short clear the face and the platform interface from the first page to the last
Clips with third-party music stay at 60 s or less for YouTube

intake.ask: Which platforms are the clips for: TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn?
intake.why: Each profile sets the length cap, the caption style and whether music must stay under 60 s
intake.default: TikTok, Reels and Shorts, one vertical render each clip

intake.ask: How many clips do you want, and is there a topic, guest or moment you want included?
intake.why: Sets shorts:prepare --count and lets the agent quote the moments the user already remembers

intake.ask: What is the source: podcast, interview, webinar or stream, talk, lesson?
intake.why: Picks the variant: a webinar adds chapters and a summary clip; a podcast needs speaker labels and question-plus-answer clips

intake.ask: May we pay for Scribe transcription (needed for clean filler cuts and speaker labels)?
intake.why: speech:local is free but not verbatim and labels speakers only with a configured HF_TOKEN; Scribe needs the user's go-ahead

intake.ask: Is there music or other copyrighted material in the recording?
intake.why: A YouTube Short over 1 minute with any copyright claim is blocked worldwide; such clips stay at 60 s or less

profiles.note: Band from the shorts:prepare defaults (house rule); TikTok's ads spec page takes 9:16 up to 10 minutes; the band is ours
Reels upload up to 3 minutes (January 2025); the 20-90 s band is the shorts:prepare house rule
Shorts run up to 3 minutes, but a Short over 1 minute with any copyright claim is blocked; 60 s keeps a claimed clip viewable
LinkedIn takes 3 s to 15 min at 1:2.4 to 2.4:1; calm sentence captions for a professional, often muted feed (band is a house rule)

starter.note: outline-pop for most clips; single-punch for one loud speaker; clean-sentence for LinkedIn, lessons and two-person clips (caption styles table)

variants.title: Webinar or stream repurposing
variants.changes: Recut the dead air first (setup, 'can you see my screen', Q&A waits) and rank against the recut; chapters for the full replay from the recut's SRT; clips keep the screen when the point is on it (square or a static crop instead of a face track); one summary clip as a hand-written recording-edit request with chronological keepSpans

variants.title: Podcast or interview clips
variants.changes: Speaker labels (--speakers N); a clip carries the question and the whole answer, and its hook may be the strongest line of the answer only when the clip still makes sense without the question; the vertical crop follows the speaker map or angles; captions break at speaker changes
